contract: GET /api/search/chapters answers 401 without a token; a missing, empty, wrong-length, non-alphanumeric or array asin answers 200 with {error: Invalid ASIN, stringKey: MessageInvalidAsin} (the web client reads data.stringKey) and never a 4xx/500; a valid 10-char ASIN fetches the fixed external Audnexus host, whose chapters or Chapters-not-found answer is not asserted here.
exceptions: normal is not applicable: a valid ASIN fetches the fixed external host api.audnex.us, so the chapter payload is not asserted; the offline auth and ASIN-validation paths are.

Unexecuted here: the built-in provider success paths (google, itunes, openlibrary, fantlab, audiobookcovers, audible) call fixed external hosts, so their result parsing and fuzzy fallback are not asserted by this packet; every deterministic offline path is asserted.

invariants.contract: GET /api/search/chapters answers 401 without a token; for a missing asin, an empty asin, SHORT, B00000000!, a 9-character value, or asin repeated twice it answers 200 with error Invalid ASIN and stringKey MessageInvalidAsin; none of these answers 400 or contacts Audnexus.
